# Psalm 68 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the music director. A song. A psalm of David.

**2** Rise up, O God, and scatter Your enemies. Let those who hate God run for their lives.

**3** Blow them away like smoke. Melt them like wax in a fire. Let the wicked perish in the presence of God.

**4** But let the godly rejoice. Let them be glad in God's presence. Let them be filled with joy.

**5** Sing praises to God and to His name! Sing loud praises to Him who rides the clouds. His name is the LORD — rejoice in His presence!

**6** Father to the fatherless, defender of widows — this is God, whose dwelling is holy.

**7** God places the lonely in families; He sets the prisoners free and gives them joy. But the rebellious must live in a sun-scorched land.

**8** O God, when You marched out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Pause and reflect

**9** the earth trembled, and the heavens poured down rain before You, the God of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.

**10** You sent abundant rain, O God, to refresh the weary land.

**11** There Your people finally settled, and with a bountiful harvest, O God, You provided for Your needy people.

**12** The Lord gives the word, and a great army brings the good news.

**13** Enemy kings and their armies flee, while the women of Israel divide the plunder.

**14** Even those who lived among the sheepfolds found treasures — doves with wings of silver and feathers of gold.

**15** The Almighty scattered the enemy kings like a blizzard on Mount Zalmon.

**16** The mountains of Bashan are majestic, with many peaks stretching high into the sky.

**17** Why do you look with envy, O rugged mountains, at Mount Zion, where God has chosen to live, where the LORD will live forever?

**18** Surrounded by unnumbered thousands of chariots, the Lord came from Mount Sinai into His sanctuary.

**19** When You ascended to the heights, You led a crowd of captives. You received gifts from the people, even from those who rebelled against You. Now the LORD God will live among us there.

**20** Praise the Lord; praise God our savior! For each day He carries us in His arms. Pause and reflect.

**21** Our God is a God who saves! The Sovereign LORD rescues us from death.

**22** But God will smash the heads of His enemies, crushing the skulls of those who love their guilty ways.

**23** The Lord says, 'I will bring My enemies down from Bashan; I will bring them up from the depths of the sea.

**24** You, My people, will wash your feet in their blood, and even your dogs will get their share!'

**25** Your procession has come into view, O God — the procession of my God and King as He goes into the sanctuary.

**26** Singers are in front, musicians behind; between them are young women playing tambourines.

**27** Praise God, all you people of Israel; praise the LORD, the source of Israel's life.

**28** Look! The little tribe of Benjamin leads the way. Then comes the great throng of rulers from Judah and all the rulers of Zebulun and Naphtali.

**29** Summon Your might, O God. Display Your power, O God, as You have in the past.

**30** The kings of the earth will bring tribute to Your temple in Jerusalem.

**31** Rebuke these enemy nations — these wild animals lurking in the reeds, this herd of bulls among the weaker calves. Make them bring bars of silver in surrender. Scatter the nations that delight in war.

**32** Let Egypt come with gifts of precious metals; let Ethiopia bring tribute to God.

**33** Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth. Sing praises to the Lord. Pause and reflect.

**34** Sing praises to Him who rides across the ancient heavens, His mighty voice thundering from the sky.

**35** Tell everyone about God's power. His majesty shines down on Israel; His strength is mighty in the heavens.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **68:5-6**: God is simultaneously cosmic warrior and tender parent. He rides the heavens AND settles the lonely in families. Power and compassion are unified.

— PNEUMA
